notes: Unassigning a product no longer 500s. The backend used to reject revokes on assignment rows missing the optional 'origin' metadata; that check is gone. 'Already revoked' is now idempotent (returns OK) so a double-click during the UI refresh window doesn't make a cleanly-revoked assignment look broken

Settings tabs and Products sub-tabs are now in the URL. Hard-refreshing on Products → Assignment lands back on Products → Assignment (not the default Backup defaults tab), and you can paste a link to a colleague and they'll land on the same view
